subject: [PATCH v5 2/3] mm/vmscan: add pgrotate_anon and pgrotate_file vmstat counters

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch adds two new vmstat counters, pgrotate_anon and pgrotate_file, to track the amount of work done by reclaim on anonymous and file-backed pages without immediately reclaiming or demoting a corresponding amount of memory. The counters are distinct from the existing pgrotated event, which records an actual move to the inactive-list tail. The patch also updates various kernel files to include these new counters in their respective statistics. This change is part of a larger effort to improve the balance between anonymous and file-backed scan workloads.

reviews.author: Usama Arif (author)
reviews.summary: Author disagreed with Sashiko's review of MGLRU, stating that they will ignore the feedback unless the MGLRU maintainers consider it an issue.

I do think the sashiko reviews in [1] about MGLRU are not correct.

I am going to ignore those unless the MGLRU maintainers think its an issue.
